variants.label: Tabs + split + snippets
variants.notes: Tabs like the file manager (green dot = your user, red = root, blue = SSH), two panes side by side, snippets drawer on the right, status bar with sudo timer.

variants.label: Immersive
variants.notes: Terminal fills the whole area. Floating toolbar, a command palette (Ctrl Shift P) for snippets and history, tmux-style session pills at the bottom.

variants.label: Sessions sidebar
variants.notes: Sessions listed on the left, including detached ones that keep running after you close the browser and saved SSH hosts. Snippets as colored chips under the terminal.
